profile.headline: cambuchi.github.io
profile.summary:
Goal oriented problem solver with a history of successful executive leadership. Will gladly dive into voraciously learning new skills to fill whatever niches are needed to ultimately support my team to create the most promising products and business growth lines. I thrive on new challenges with the discipline and passion to back it up.

Strengths: Discipline | Communication | Organization | Versatility

positions.locationName: Lake Oswego, Oregon, United States · Remote

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Bug solver: impact analysis, reproduction, root cause identification, and code corrections.
•	Specializing in diving into unfamiliar code bases to identify problems in C#, SQL, AWS, and JavaScript.

positions.title: Customer Support Specialist
positions.description:
•	Supported products increased to include Conflict of Interest Disclosure Management Software and became a subject matter expert (SME) for the NAVEX One platform.
•	Became significant contributor to SQL query requests for the PolicyTech Team.
•	Consistently elevating team performance by hosting office hours for COI/ NAVEX One, assisting with escalated cases, being a crucial presence for product knowledge, and creating documentation for complex topics like Wireshark; Entra/Okta implementation; and updating ADFS certificates.
•	Nominated for Customer Support Technician of the Quarter awards for 6 out of 8 quarters.

positions.title: Software Engineer Traveler
positions.description:
•	6 month internship with Sustenance Engineering covering full stack production support for SaaS applications.
•	Worked in an Agile environment utilizing C#, SQL, AWS, Postman, Docker, Typescript, and Git.
•	Updated on-boarding processes, led scrum, and participated in code reviews as well as retrospectives.

positions.title: Vice President
positions.description: Planned and led ISO 9001:2008 certification project to completion and received certification from ANAB accredited DNV GL. Set up and managed an IT Network of 9 workstations, 17 Computer Numerical Control (CNC) Machines, 2 Coordinate Measuring Machines (CMM); Manage the company's QC and Internal Audits. Managed and drove company quality and on time delivery company statistic to over 97%. Managed sales leads for both R&D and production machining as well as maintaining and fostering customer relationships. Part of executive management team that led company expansion from 5000 to 10000 square feet. Planned and led transitional ISO 9001:2008 to ISO: 9001:2015 certification project to completion. Manage and led project to upgrade company network to enterprise grade firewall protocol with end-to-end network security. Managed company transition to enterprise level ERP software with custom crystal report designs. Manages QA team that produces all training documentation and training materials for employees. Point of contact for any critical company issue, manufacturing clarifications, or quality control issues. Led and managed project for AS9100 certification to completion for aerospace manufacturing. Regularly traveled to Vietnam to set-up production branch and ensure quality standards were compliant with industry certifications.

positions.title: Administrator
positions.description: Overseeing the expansion of the company. Heading initiative to acquire industry certification for medical devices and quality assurance. Acquisition of new manufacturing facilities. Reorganization of company from paper to electronic bookkeeping and file organization. Diversification of market sources for contracts. Sales representative. Wrote numerous VBA programs that increased quote rate by over 200% (compared to last year) and scheduled production. Created company website and managed online presence. Design prototypes for customers using modern CAD software.

positions.title: Instructor and after-school programs manager
positions.description: Volunteer Teacher. Taught internet communications technology, English, math, health, science, social studies, and Asante Twi to three classes of students ranging from ages 12 - 21. Began and taught after-school programs such as evening classes and after-school sports.

positions.title: Physiotherapy Intern
positions.description:
Was an intern at Ridge Regional hospital's physiotherapy department. Trained in physiotherapy while doing paperwork regarding patients'​ information, progress, and health status. Five month internship taken in West Africa for Princeton's Bridge Year, a gap year program that takes place before college begins.

Hours: 5:00 AM - 4:00 PM Mon - Fri

honors.title: Gates Millennium Scholar
honors.description:
Awarded scholarship under the Gates Millennium Scholars Program.

The Gates Millennium Scholars (GMS) program, established in 1999, is a 1.6 billion dollar initiative funded by grant from the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation.
The goal of the GMS program is to promote academic excellence and to provide an opportunity for outstanding minority students with significant financial need to reach their highest potential.
Each applicant was evaluated in terms of first having a complete package, which consists of the following: a student application, a Nominator Form and a Recommender Form. Students were also evaluated on academic achievement, community service and leadership potential.
honors.issuer: Issued by Gates Millennium Scholars Program (Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation) · Apr 2010
